questions.question: You are in a meeting with your manager. He has made a mistake in a report. Which response is the most appropriate?
options: That's a terrible idea.
I'm afraid I made a mistake in the figures.
You should have checked it yourself.
It's not my fault.
questions.answer: I'm afraid I made a mistake in the figures.

questions.question: A friend calls you late at night and says they are having trouble finding their way home. What is the best thing to say?
options: It's too late for me to help.
I can call a taxi for you if you like.
You should just walk back to your hotel.
Why didn't you ask for directions earlier?
questions.answer: I can call a taxi for you if you like.

questions.question: Your colleague asks you to lend them your laptop because theirs is broken. How should you respond?
options: Sure, here you go.
No way, I need it for work.
Okay, but only for an hour.
I don't have a laptop.

questions.question: You are at a formal dinner party. Someone asks for your opinion on the food. Which response is most suitable?
options: It's absolutely delicious!
I don't know what I'm talking about.
It's okay, nothing special.
I hate this kind of food.

questions.question: You want to suggest that your partner go to the gym instead of staying home all day. Which option is the most polite?
options: You should go to the gym.
I think it would be a good idea to get some exercise.
Stop wasting your time at home.
Why are you not moving?
questions.answer: I think it would be a good idea to get some exercise.
